caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance, measured as accuracy across 11 datasets, for five different training methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Average Performance,” ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, with horizontal gridlines at each 10-unit interval. The horizontal x-axis lists the five methods in left-to-right order. Each method is represented by a single colored bar: Standard (orange) reaches approximately 53; Self-RAG (light brown) is slightly higher at around 54; FactTune (light green) is slightly lower at about 52; CInGS (w/) (blue-gray) is near 55; and CInGS (dark blue) achieves the highest performance at approximately 59. The bars are not sorted by value and are evenly spaced, with no additional annotations or error bars. The chart visually emphasizes CInGS as the top-performing method under the evaluated conditions.
